report.candidate_letter:
Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the Data Scientist position. We regret to inform you that your application has been rejected. The following must-have requirements were not met: knowledge of probability theory and statistics, understanding of Bayesian methods or time series analysis, hands-on experience with probabilistic programming (e.g., Pyro, PyMC3), experience with Amazon SageMaker, and experience with PySpark.

This decision was made after a human review. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
